name: SMS Co., Ltd.
summary: SMS Co., Ltd. provides information infrastructure for the nursing care, medical care, career, healthcare, and elderly care field business areas in Japan and internationally. It operates an online community site for professionals or families engaged in nursing care; a certification course information portal; and a housing information portal for seniors, as well as a home-delivered meal search site. The company also develops medical, health and productivity management support, and global HCP supply platform. In addition, it provides recruiting agent services, as well as recruiting ads services for professionals and operators in nursing and medical care fields. Further, the company offers medical-related services. SMS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
